git.commit_message: fix: Make Docker build conditional on Docker Hub secrets

footage_conditions: Real Indian truck license plates, mixed lighting, various image sizes (574x1280 to 1599x1600)
limitations: Dataset has license plate bboxes only (not full vehicle bboxes), so vehicle detection IoU calibration not possible. Plate OCR on raw crops without dedicated plate detector. Small sample: 16 images, 17 plates. EasyOCR struggles with Indian plate formats (two-line, hand-painted fonts, obstructions).
honesty_notes: All metrics are targets to measure, never published without documented tests.
Hardware, footage conditions, and sample size are recorded with every result.
Test records are append-only — never modify or delete historical records.
Human review mandatory — no automatic fines.
Stop time alone does NOT imply guilt.
